text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali discussed with visiting German Parliament speaker Rita Sussmuth the Europe Union's contribution to the Middle East peace process.
- French President Jacques Chirac says he expects with great interest President Ben Ali's visit to France before the end of this year.
- President Ben Ali named Said Ben Mustapha ambassador to Italy.
- The trade Ministry announced that the minimum prices of olive oil for export were freed starting on Saturday May 10.
- Good start for the tourism sector in 1997. Number of nights rose between 7.7 percent and 15.8 percent during the three first months of 1997 compared with the same period in 1996.
- A Tunis court started looking at the "gold affair" in which about 100 people were charged in 1995. The trial is to resume next Wednesday.
- President Ben Ali calls for a greater European Union role in the Middle East peace process.
